source.title: Pires-Fonseca and Carrasco-Altemani,2024, Figure8 plate-fin series
source.missing_point_policy: No missing or overlapping13th marker is invented

source_conditioning.response: Approximate vector-marker Rth=(Tb-Tin)/qcv; qcv is electrical power minus estimated losses, not raw temperatures
source_conditioning.speed: Nozzle flow divided equally among17 channels; reported V mapped to arithmetic interior-channel area
source_conditioning.properties: Source numerical air properties, not recovered per-run conditions; aluminum conductivity independently declared

residual_display: 100 times relative_Rth_discrepancy is percent resistance difference; positive means higher predicted resistance and lower predicted conductance
field_display_contract: Match channel_index_from_side to display_fields.channel_domains; channel8 is a half-channel with modeled_width_fraction0.5
display_warning: Integrity checks and numerical equivalence are not experimental or aircraft validation.
